content.title: Replay: Riolu Hatch Day - Leek Duck | Pokémon GO News and Resources
content.text: Aura you ready for Replay: Riolu Hatch Day? Riolu will hatch much more frequently from 2 km Eggs, and you’ll have an increased chance of hatching Shiny Riolu!The Replay: Riolu Hatch Day event will take place on April 18, 2026 from 11 am to 5 pm. 2× Candy from hatching Eggs2× XP from hatching Eggs1/2 Egg Hatch DistanceIncreased chance of hatching Shiny RioluIncreased chance of receiving 2 km Eggs from spinning PokéStops*These bonuses will not stack with bonuses from Pokémon GO events or GO Passes.Ticketed BonusPurchasing the optional ticket will grant the following bonus during Replay: Riolu Hatch Day.1/4 Egg Hatch Distance*This bonus will not stack with bonuses from Pokémon GO events or GO Passes.Featured PokémonRiolu will hatch much more frequently from 2 km Eggs. You’ll also have an increased chance of hatching Shiny Riolu!Riolu Event-exclusive Timed ResearchEvent-exclusive Timed Research awarding an Incubator and 5,000 XP will be available at no cost!Please note that Timed Research expires. The tasks associated with Timed Research must be completed and their rewards must be claimed before Saturday, April 18, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. local time.Replay: Riolu Hatch Day (1/1) ??? ×1Incubator ×15000 XPPremium Timed ResearchFor US$1.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency), you’ll be able to access event-exclusive Timed Research. Purchasing this ticket will also grant the following bonus during Replay: Riolu Hatch Day.1/4 Egg Hatch Distance*This paid Timed Research will challenge you to explore 1 km to earn the following items.One Star PieceTwo Super IncubatorsAnd more!Replay: Riolu Hatch Day (1/1) Explore 1 km Please note that the paid Timed Research expires. The tasks associated with the paid Timed Research must be completed and their rewards must be claimed before Saturday, April 18, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. local time.*This bonus will not stack with bonuses from Pokémon GO events or GO Passes.You’ll have an increased chance of hatching Shiny Riolu during this event.RioluLucarioPokémon GO Web Store – Replay: Riolu Hatch Day Ultra Ticket BoxThe Replay: Riolu Hatch Day Ultra Ticket Box will be available for US$1.99 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency).
